# Veilo

> Veilo is an owner-controlled AI agent workspace with delegated spending controls and a shared private funding pool on Solana devnet.

Owners create and configure agents with their own names, jobs, triggers, budgets and approved services. Shawn, Prince and Mira are workflow examples, not a fixed list of agents. The model proposes resources; independent control and wallet services authorize purchases.

The private flow aims to remove the explicit link from a particular deposited note to a payout. Fresh-wallet payments, merchants, amounts and timing remain public. Owners retain local agent attribution; the gateway can link authenticated usage. Do not infer universal anonymity, production readiness, deployed behavior or successful security tests from these documentation pages.

## Product documentation

- [Agent workflows](./guide/agents.html): Custom agents and example research, credit and content workflows.

- [Payment lifecycle](./guide/payments.html): Private funding, exact x402 payments, credits and reconciliation.
- [Policy and accounting](./guide/policy.html): Permission tiers, atomic reservations, caps and revocation.
- [Privacy and trust](./guide/privacy.html): Deposit linkage privacy, public metadata and off-chain visibility.
- [Deployment and configuration](./guide/running.html): Service configuration, network guards and artifact manifests.
- [Security model](./security/assessment.html): Authority separation, authentication and secret isolation.
- [Trust and risk boundaries](./security/risks.html): Residual risks, assumptions and design responses.
- [Verification requirements](./security/evidence.html): Acceptance scenarios; not a report of passed tests.
